name: Bounding
steps: Start in an open lane with a brief rhythmic jog or staggered athletic stance to build smooth forward momentum.
Drive explosively forward and upward off one foot while punching your opposite knee high and forward with vigorous arm swing.
Stretch out cleanly in midair with your back leg extended straight behind you, then pull your lead foot down beneath your hip.
Land elastically on your midfoot and rebound immediately off that leg into the next alternating bound.
tips: Strike the ground actively beneath your hips rather than reaching your heel far out in front of you.
Keep your torso tall and drive through full hip extension on every single takeoff.
